---
title: "After the session"
---
The session stops before two parts of the exercise that need more time than it has. The first is the class chart, on which every participant puts the specification that they explored in Task 4 and the one that they declared in Task 5, so that the class can read its own results against the curve. The second is Task 5 itself, in which you choose one specification and fix it in a preregistration block before you run it. Both are set out in the [exercise overview](../../cases/housing/exercise.qmd), both run in the [browser lab](../../cases/housing/lab.qmd#task-5-preregistration), and both run in the downloadable workspace, which you can install by following the [setup page](../../setup.qmd) and keep afterwards. The [one-day course on methods](../housing-one-day-methods/index.qmd) works through them in class, the [one-day course on open science](../housing-one-day-open-science/index.qmd) takes reproduction, replication and preregistration further, and the [one-day course on data tools](../housing-one-day-data-tools/index.qmd) puts the reproduction into a report of your own.

The [companion curriculum](../../companion/index.qmd) covers what the session could only mention in passing, in modules that each stand on their own.

| If you want | Read |
|---|---|
| The design of the experiment: random assignment, names as treatments, comparisons among replies, randomisation inference, power and the ethics of deception | [Audit experiments](../../companion/experiments.qmd) |
| Every model on the menu, from a difference in proportions to the logit, and how to read odds ratios against percentage points | [Binary outcomes](../../companion/binary-outcomes.qmd) |
| The causal graph of Task 2 at a slower pace | [Causal graphs and conditioning](../../companion/dags.qmd), with the graph cell of the [browser lab](../../cases/housing/lab.qmd#task-2-estimand-and-graph) |
| The ideas behind the curve, and the arguments now being made against them | [The multiverse and its critics](../../companion/multiverse.qmd) |
| The replication with new data, in its own words and on its own data | The final report at [osf.io/2ug8x](https://osf.io/2ug8x/), and the de-identified data, the do-file and a dictionary at [osf.io/xseqg](https://osf.io/xseqg/) |
| R from the beginning, on the same data | [Getting started with R](../../companion/intro-r.qmd) |
| To archive and version a report of your own | [Reproducibility repositories](../../companion/repositories.qmd), then [Git and GitHub](../../companion/git-github.qmd) |
